name: spindoctor_run_script
description:
Run one or more SpinDoctor q.* commands (one per line) in the persistent simulator workspace and return each result plus TXT/JSON/PDF report paths. Classical FP64 simulation only; not a quantum computer. Example: 'q.circuit new bell 2
q.circuit add h 0
q.circuit add cx 0 1
q.circuit run shots 1000 basis z'.

script.description: q.* commands, one per line; blank lines and # comments are ignored.

name: spindoctor_run_preset
description: Run one of the 241 built-in SpinDoctor presets (qc-001..qc-241) with optional name=value overrides; returns per-step results and report paths.

overrides.description: Optional overrides (shots, basis, qubits, input, angle).

name: spindoctor_list_presets
description: List the SpinDoctor presets (id, category, label, availability, commands). Optional case-insensitive filter text.

name: spindoctor_report
description: Return the text of a SpinDoctor report (TXT) from the workspace, or list the newest reports when no name is given.

name.description: Report file name or path relative to <workspace>/reports (e.g. qc-061.txt).

limit.description: How many recent reports to list (default 20).

name: spindoctor_functions
description: Return the in-chat Markdown table of EVERY SpinDoctor function: columns Function | What it does | Command to type, grouped by command family, with real runnable examples (plus the 241 presets with section='presets'). Show the table to the user verbatim when they ask what the plugin can do, ask for help/functions, or on first use.

section.description: commands (default: tools + every q.* family + gates), gates, tools, presets (241 rows) or all.

name: spindoctor_test_theory
description: Test a theory/experiment with the simulator and write a TXT+JSON+PDF theory test report (hypothesis, script, raw results, verdict supported / not supported / inconclusive, limits). source='file': a .txt/.md/.pdf/.py/.json/.csv/.q attachment by local path; source='text': pasted text; source='chat': a theory summary the AI wrote from the conversation and the user confirmed, plus optional quoted excerpts and/or an exported chat transcript (.txt/.md/.json/.html). Use action='extract' first to read the source, then action='run' with hypothesis, prediction, checks and a q.* script. The plugin cannot read chat history or host attachments by itself.

action.description: extract = read/parse the source only; run (default) = run the script, compare, write the report.

path.description: Local path of the attachment (source=file) or of an exported chat transcript (source=chat).

text.description: Pasted theory text (source=text) or the confirmed theory summary: claims, assumptions, variables, measurable prediction (source=chat).

excerpts.description: source=chat: verbatim quotes from the conversation, e.g. 'User: ...', 'Assistant: ...'.

hypothesis.description: The hypothesis restated in one or two sentences (required for run).

prediction.description: The measurable prediction in words (required for run).

checks.description: Machine checks. {kind:'probability', outcome:'00', expected:0.5, tolerance:0.05, command?:N} (bitstrings: qubit 0 is the RIGHTMOST bit; uses the last histogram or zero/one counts) | {kind:'value', command:N, path:'result.fidelity', op:'approx|eq|ne|lt|le|gt|ge|contains|true|false', value:X, tolerance?:T} | {kind:'ok', command:N, expected:true}.

script.description: q.* commands, one per line (defaults to q.* lines found in the source).

isolate.description: Default true: run in a fresh sub-workspace (<workspace>/theory-runs/<id>) so names never collide; false = use the shared workspace state.
